cases.task: Choose the safe keepalive policy for an SSE endpoint whose configurable poll interval ranges from 50 milliseconds to 5 seconds.

required_facts.text: A fixed count of idle poll iterations makes wall-clock keepalive latency scale with poll_ms.
At 40 ticks and poll_ms=5000, the first keepalive can be delayed for 200 seconds.
Common proxies may close an otherwise healthy idle stream before 200 seconds.
The keepalive cadence should be bounded by elapsed duration across every accepted poll interval.
